MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of March 2, 2026 (the "Effective
Date") between Larkspur Systems, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Provider"), and Brightwater Logistics
LLC, an Oregon limited liability company ("Customer"). Provider and Customer agree as follows.
1 Services
Provider will make the Larkspur Route Intelligence platform (the "Service") available to Customer and its
authorized users in accordance with this Agreement and each order form signed by both parties. Provider
may update the Service from time to time, provided that no update will materially reduce the functionality
of the Service during a paid term.
2 Term
The initial term of this Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for thirty-six (36) months (the
"Initial Term").
3 Renewal
After the Initial Term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless
either party gives writen notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current
term.
4.1 Fees
Customer will pay Provider an annual subscription fee of $184,000 for the Service, invoiced annually in
advance. Fees are stated in U.S. dollars and are exclusive of taxes.
4.2 Payment Terms
Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Customer must
notify Provider of any disputed amount before the due date and pay the undisputed portion on time.
4.3 Late Payment
Overdue amounts accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month, or the highest rate permitted by law if lower,
from the due date until paid.
4.4 Fee Adjustments
Provider may increase the fees for any renewal term by up to 5% over the fees for the preceding term by
giving notice at least ninety (90) days before the renewal date.
5 Service Levels
Provider will maintain monthly availability of the Service of at least 99.9%. If Provider fails to meet this
commitment in a calendar month, Customer will recieve a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly fee for
each full hour of unavailability, up to a maximum of 10% of the monthly fee for that month. Service credits
are Customer's sole remedy for unavailability.
Page 1

 
6 Customer Data
Customer owns all data it submits to the Service ("Customer Data"). Provider will process Customer Data
only to provide the Service. For thirty (30) days after termination or expiration, Provider will make
Customer Data available for export, after which Provider will delete it.
7 Intellectual Property
Provider retains all right, title and interest in the Service, including all configurations, integrations and
improvements developed in connection with this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement transfers ownership
of any intellectual property to Customer.
8 Confidentiality
Each party will protect the other party's confidential information using reasonable care and will use it only
to perform this Agreement. These obligations continue for three (3) years after termination or expiration of
this Agreement.
9 Limitation of Liability
Except for a party's indemnification obligations, each party's total liability arising out of or related to this
Agreement will not exceed the fees paid by Customer under this Agreement in the sixty (60) months before
the event giving rise to the claim. Neither party will be liable for indirect, incidental or consequential
damages.
10 Indemnification
Provider will defend Customer against any third-party claim that the Service infringes a patent, copyright or
trademark, and will pay damages finally awarded. Customer will defend Provider against any third-party
claim arising from Customer Data.
11 Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty (30)
days after written notice. Neither party may terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial
Term or any renewal term.
12 Assignment
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, except to a
successor in a merger or sale of substantially all of its assets. Any seperate attempt to assign is void.
13 Notices
Notices must be in writing and sent to the addresses below. Provider: Larkspur Systems, Inc., 1200 Cascade
Avenue, Suite 900, Wilmington, Delaware 19801. Customer: Brightwater Logistics LLC, 410 Quay Street,
Suite 200, Portland, Oregon 97204. E-mail notice is effective when acknowledged.
14 Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws
rules. The parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Wilmington,
Delaware.
Page 2

 
15 General
This Agreement, together with each order form, is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes
all prior discussions. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties. If any provision is
unenforceable, the remaining provisions stay in effect.
16 Most Favoured Customer
If Provider offers the Service to any other customer of similar size at lower fees during the term, Provider
will promptly offer the same fees to Customer and refund the difference for the preceding twelve (12)
months.
